title: Azure Cloud Architect
description: WHO WE ARE Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services. We offer solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Accenture Song. For more information about Accenture Technology Poland please visit our website . THE WORK As an Cloud Architect in our Accenture Cloud First team, you will help enterprise clients design and evolve secure, scalable and cost‑efficient cloud landscapes, supporting their digital transformation journeys. Your work will include: Designing end‑to‑end architectures for cloud, hybrid and on‑premises environments on Microsoft Azure, including Azure Landing Zones, governance and security models. Defining and implementing compute environments (autoscaling, load balancing, serverless solutions), Azure database services and CI/CD pipelines, with integration to existing on‑premises services. Designing cloud‑native networking (VNETs, peering, firewalls, container networking) and security & compliance controls (IAM, resource hierarchy, data security, cost management and billing). Implementing monitoring, logging, profiling and alerting solutions to ensure reliability and observability of client platforms. Preparing migration approaches and onboarding plans to Azure, including effort estimation, cost and resource calculations, and optimization scenarios. Partnering with DevOps and engineering teams to apply Infrastructure as Code and automation practices, improve delivery pipelines and support a mature DevOps culture. Leading or supporting incident, request, change and problem management activities, acting as a trusted technical advisor for client stakeholders. Flexible: The work location for this role may include a mix of working remotely, onsite at a client or in an Accenture office - depending on specific project circumstances. With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs. WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU? Join Accenture’s Cloud First team if you are motivated to embrace new opportunities, enthusiastic about professional growth and dedicated to evolving your skills. You will: Work on large‑scale cloud transformation projects for international enterprise clients, expanding your Azure and architecture skill set. Shape modern cloud, hybrid and on‑premises platforms using automation, containers and DevOps practices, continuously enhancing your technical expertise. Collaborate with experienced cloud professionals in a diverse team, gaining insights and feedback that support your continuous learning and development. HERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEED: 5+ years of hands‑on experience in Azure cloud infrastructure engineering. In‑depth knowledge of Microsoft Azure, supported by advanced/Expert‑level Azure certifications. Ability to oversee the work of development teams, plan their tasks and translate technical requirements into a structured and actionable backlog. Experience designing and planning highly available systems, including implementing Disaster Recovery strategies. Ability to translate client business requirements into technical specifications and ensure their implementation through appropriate configurations within a broader Landing Zone architecture. Strong understanding of container technologies and orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, OpenShift, AKS). Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation tools. Solid grasp of virtualization technologies. Comprehensive knowledge of DevOps culture, practices and tools (e.g., Jenkins, Git/GitLab, Pipelines, Helm charts, ArgoCD). Ability to develop scripts and applications using at least one language (e.g., Bash or Python). Experience in cost and resource calculations, as well as optimization for cloud environments. Enterprise architecture experience within public cloud environments, including creating migration plans and managing onboarding processes. Proficiency in troubleshooting and managing incidents, requests, changes and problems. Upper‑intermediate level of English and Polish (spoken and written). Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team. BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE: Experience with at least one modern programming language (e.g., PowerShell, Azure CLI, Node.js, React, .NET, Python or Java). Expertise in one or more Azure service categories, such as: Azure systems infrastructure (Windows/Linux OS, networking, storage, high availability, disaster recovery, cloud security, application performance). App Services (Web Apps, Mobile Apps, API Apps, Logic Apps). Experience in technical sales support or pre‑sales activities. Kubernetes Developer or Security‑oriented certification. description: About Accenture Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with 774,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities. Visit us at www.accenture.com As an experienced Supply and Engineering Data & AI Solution Architect, you play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering AI solutioning for asset-intensive clients — mining, oil and gas, utilities, chemicals, heavy transport, defence, critical infrastructure, and capital projects. Operating at the intersection of industry domain, client engagement, and engineering, you own the end-to-end solution path from discovery and competitive pursuit through architecture and delivery shaping. You design advanced AI systems that combine agentic architectures with classical machine learning, optimisation, and constraint-based decision techniques, purposefully mapped to how the client's operation actually works. Soft skills and industry fluency are load-bearing: you are equally credible with executives, domain engineers, and technical teams. You can provide the technical expertise and collaboration to translate frontier technology deployments into quantified business value cases regularly connecting technical architecture to COO/CFO-level investment narratives. You understand what it takes to make technology stay operational after go-live, including tailoring operating model and organisational change capabilities as appropriate for solutions to be effective in an organization. You also lead and mentor people by default - growing capability, standards, compelling visions and reusable assets throughout your ecosystem. THE WORK Lead client discovery, executive briefings, and technical deep-dives — translating the same solution across C-suite, operations, engineering, and IT architecture audiences without losing substance. Facilitate stakeholder workshops to surface pain, align feasibility, prioritise use cases, and leave a clear path to pilot or mobilisation. Shape pursuits and proposals (RFI/RFP, competitive tenders, solution plans): overlay proven reference patterns onto the client's named systems, processes, vocabulary, and quantified pain — never present a generic case as if it were theirs. Translate operational and commercial strategy into a technical vision, defining functional and non-functional requirements for performance, reliability, auditability, safety, and cost. In collaboration with your colleagues, translate your technical visions back into quantified business value cases for C-suite and executive audiences, connecting investment to measurable operational outcomes. Architect multi-agent systems (orchestration, tool-calling, plan-and-execute, grounding, evaluation) with explicit human-in-the-loop and audit trails where operators must retain control. Combine agentic techniques with classical methods where they belong: LP/MIP and operations-research optimisers, constraint solvers, forecasting and classical ML, simulation, knowledge graphs, and retrieval-augmented generation. Define the seams between agents, optimisers, and human decision-makers — when the system decides, when it recommends, and when a coordinator or engineer must approve. Drive build-vs-buy and technology selection for AI and decision platforms. Architect end-to-end data and context layers for industrial and supply-chain environments, including grounded retrieval and knowledge modelling — spanning cloud, edge, and OT environments including historian systems, industrial data architectures, and the data latency and protocol constraints (OPC-UA, Modbus, DNP3) that govern real-time operational technology. Elicit and codify hard, soft, and dynamic operational constraints with domain SMEs until plans and recommendations are executable in the real operation. Frame coupled, multi-domain decision problems as connected systems (for example yard ↔ rail ↔ crew, or commercial demand ↔ marine/ops supply) rather than siloed point tools. Separate what is proven, assumed, and still to be confirmed; rebuild value cases on the client's own data and pain, not on reference-client results. Produce and own authoritative solution artefacts: architecture blueprints, decision frameworks, overlay crosswalks, sequence designs, and Architectural Decision Records (ADRs). Independently design and deliver proof-of-concept prototypes that validate architectural decisions with clients and delivery teams. Drive frontier technology from pilot to scaled operational deployment — collaboratively defining post-go-live operating models, governance structures, and workforce capability requirements that ensure AI and digital systems remain operational and continue delivering value after handover. Ensure consideration and coordination with auxiliary Accenture teams to design and deliver solutions for sovereign, regulated, or restricted-access environments — including air-gapped deployments, OT cybersecurity architecture, and data sovereignty requirements for Defence, critical infrastructure, and government clients. Integrate autonomous systems, robotics, and physical AI into industrial solution architectures — understanding how AI decisions translate into physical action in field, plant, and asset environments, and designing the control, safety, and audit layers that responsible deployment requires. Operate as a capability lead within a matrixed, multi-discipline practice — maintaining active interlocks with digital engineering, value consulting, and industry go-to-market teams, and contributing to integrated solutions that span capability domains rather than individual offerings. Lead and mentor cross-functional Supply Chain and Engineering Data & AI teams (data, engineering, industry SMEs, change) on architectural intent, client standards of evidence, and engagement craft. Build and grow the Supply Chain and Engineering Data & AI offering: develop capabilities, coach practitioners, and contribute reusable solution patterns and reference architectures back into the practice. Continuously research and integrate emerging agentic and decision-intelligence patterns while retaining judgement on when classical techniques remain the better tool. EDUCATION Bachelor's Degree or equivalent (Engineering, Physical Sciences, Computer Science, Operations Research, or related). Advanced degree preferred. BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATION Minimum of 8 years of experience in industry, consulting, or enterprise delivery within asset-intensive, supply-chain, or complex engineering/operations environments. Minimum of 4 years of experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade AI solutions spanning agentic, generative, and classical AI/ML — using at least one major cloud vendor (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Minimum of 3 years of experience in the agentic, LLM, and generative AI space, including orchestration patterns and human-in-the-loop design. Minimum of 3 years of experience combining AI with optimisation, operations research, constraint modelling, or classical ML for operational or commercial decision systems. Demonstrated client-facing experience leading discovery, technical deep-dives, and executive conversations — with the ability to change register across stakeholder levels, including C-suite audiences where the conversation centres on business value and investment justification rather than technical architecture. Demonstrated experience shaping pursuits or proposals (RFI/RFP responses, solution architecture for competitive bids, or equivalent). Deep domain fluency in one or more of: mining, oil and gas, utilities, chemicals, heavy industry, capital projects, Defence or critical infrastructure, or complex supply-chain / engineering operations — sufficient to diagnose the real problem, not only the stated ask. Minimum of 4 years of hands-on technical experience (e.g. Python and/or solution prototyping) sufficient to validate architecture decisions and guide engineering teams. Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring teams, and contributing to offering or capability development within a Data & AI, supply chain, or engineering practice. Demonstrated experience deploying or architecting AI solutions in operational technology (OT) or industrial edge environments — including familiarity with historian systems, industrial data architectures, and the constraints of real-time OT integration. PREFERRED QUALIFICATION Background that trained systems thinking under uncertainty (e.g. engineering, geophysics/reservoir, process, reliability, OR) applied to AI solutioning. Experience designing knowledge/document intelligence or knowledge-graph solutions for technical corpora. Prior work on scheduling, planning, maintenance, production, logistics, marine/commercial supply chain, or asset performance decision systems. Experience building reusable IP, reference architectures, or practice assets that scale an offering beyond a single engagement. title: Strategy Senior Manager, Macro Foresight (CEO Advisory)
description: Role: Strategy Senior Manager - Macro Foresight Location: London Career Level: Senior Manager About Macro Foresight Macro Foresight is part of Accenture's CEO Advisory business. We work with CEOs and boards on enterprise-wide strategy and reinvention, helping them perform, protect, and grow. Within that, we are the team that anticipates disruption and volatility: we help clients read the external environment—economic, geopolitical, and financial—and build long-term strategies for competitiveness and resilience. Our footprint is global, with hubs in North America, Europe, and Asia. In the past two years we've helped leaders respond to the highest US tariffs in a century, energy and supply shocks around the Strait of Hormuz, two-speed economies, and the reordering of global trade around industrial policy and AI. What we do The work we deliver for client’s centers on a set of CEO- and board-level offerings: Economic and geopolitical impact assessments. AI-accelerated analysis of how macro and geopolitical shifts affect a business, a market, or a major investment. Scenario planning and wargaming. AI-enabled planning and table-top wargaming that test a strategy against a range of possible futures. Decision intelligence. Enterprise-wide decision support that reaches beyond macro and geopolitics into portfolio strategy, competition, consumer trends, and business performance. Strategic foresight and long-range planning. Structured futures assessments and long-range portfolio planning. Enterprise resilience assessments. CEO- and board-level diagnostics that measure and strengthen an organization's resilience to shocks. Foresight capability enablement. Helping clients build their own capability across people, process, and technology. The people we hire We hire for a few different profiles, and many people here bring more than one: Economists and geopolitical experts who read the real economy, financial and commodity markets, and the interplay of policy, trade, and security, and apply it to a client's business context. Strategists who translate complex analysis into recommendations a leadership team can act on. Entrepreneurial people who grow teams and develop those who join after them. AI engineers who code, build models, and put large language models and AI agents to work. We're actively hiring for this. People who work well with ambiguity , set their own direction, and want to help build new offerings like scenario planning, wargaming, and foresight. Senior Manager (CL6), United Kingdom We're looking for an experienced strategy leader to help drive our Macro Foresight client efforts in the UK and Ireland. Based in London, you'll own a portfolio of work, deepen senior client relationships, and build the team around you. What you'll be doing Lead and grow the UK capability. Own a portfolio of engagements and build our presence in the market. Advise the C-suite and boards on how global shifts in trade and capital flows, industrial and security policy, and technology reshape their strategy and capital allocation. Pull in the wider firm. Bring the right Accenture teams into your engagements, from industry to AI and data science, so clients get integrated answers rather than point solutions. Win the work. Spot opportunities, build senior relationships, and turn them into engagements. Set the standard on AI-enabled ways of working. Guide how the team uses models, agents, and our AI Foresight platform, and lead the productization of our offerings into AI-enabled services. Develop the team. Coach and mentor, and set a high standard for analytical and technical craft. Shape our thought leadership and external profile through our macro briefs, points of view, board-level briefings, and presence at industry forums. What we're looking for At least 8 years in strategy consulting, corporate finance, economic or geopolitical advisory, or investment, including 4+ years leading teams and complex engagements. Including: A track record of being a player-coach , who can provide leadership and mentorship, help build and grow teams, and lead from the front. Deep command of macroeconomics and geopolitics , and what they mean for large organizations. A track record of building senior client relationships and winning new work, with the credibility to engage with CEOs, C-suite clients, and board members. Fluency with AI-enabled ways of working, and the confidence to champion technical and AI-driven approaches. A bachelor's degree or equivalent experience . What will make you stand out Established C-suite / board relationships (e.g., FTSE 100, Fortune / NYSE 500). A respected voice in the market , with an active presence at conferences and in industry associations, building your name and Macro Foresight's brand. Experience with scenario planning, wargaming, or foresight offerings. A graduate degree in economics, finance, international relations, public policy, or management , or an MBA. An existing network in the UK market . The practical details You'll need the right to work in the United Kingdom. We also welcome applications from candidates who require visa sponsorship, as we are able to sponsor eligible work visas for suitable applicants. This role is based in London. This role is a hybrid role and you will be required to go into office at least 3 days a week. How we work, and how we'll back you You'll work alongside experienced economists, geopolitical experts, and strategists on demanding client work anywhere in the world, with room to build new offerings and tools of your own. As part of Accenture, you'll draw on the firm's depth in AI, data science, and industry, and as the team grows, so will your remit. title: Senior Manager, Human Capital & Talent Strategy
description: This is a senior client-facing role, sitting at the heart of our People & Organisation practice. You will be deployed directly with clients — working alongside their executive teams to solve their most complex human capital challenges, redesign how their organisations are structured and run, and build the talent capabilities that will sustain long-term performance. You will represent our practice externally, shaping client relationships, leading engagements, and translating deep expertise into outcomes that matter. This role demands equal strength in strategic thinking and stakeholder management — someone who can command a room with a CHRO as confidently as they can structure an operating model or facilitate a leadership engagement. You will bring a strategic mindset to the practice and clients as well as be comfortable in the adoption of technology and AI. You are comfortable building relationships with clients to solve their human capital challenges. What You'll Do Client Engagement & Relationship Management • Serve as the primary day-to-day client contact across human capital engagements, building trusted advisor relationships at a senior and C-suite level. • Lead client workshops, steering committee presentations, and executive briefings — translating complex analysis into clear, compelling narratives. • Manage client expectations, scope, and delivery quality across concurrent engagements. • Identify opportunities to deepen and extend client relationships, contributing to account growth and new mandate development. Operating Model & Organisational Design • Lead target operating model design engagements from current-state diagnostics through to future-state design and implementation roadmaps. • Advise clients on organisational structures, spans and layers, role architecture, and governance frameworks that align to their strategic direction. • Produce high-quality deliverables including design principles, Target Operating Model blueprints, and role accountability matrices. • Translate operating model decisions into tangible operational processes — ensuring new ways of working are practical, embedded, and measurable. • Build client-ready playbooks, governance toolkits, and implementation guides that drive adoption and accountability. HR Reinvention Shape a clients HR transformation journey by defining their future HR operating model, service delivery approach, organisation structure and capabilities required to support the business strategy. Understand the end-to-end HR capability landscape by bringing strong knowledge across areas such as talent, workforce planning, learning, performance, rewards, employee experience, HR operations and people analytics. Connect HR operating model to technology by understanding how platforms such as Workday and SAP SuccessFactors and emerging AI solutions to enable HR processes, employee experience, automation and data-driven decision-making. Talent Strategy Co-design enterprise talent strategies with clients — covering workforce planning, talent segmentation, critical role identification, and capability frameworks. Lead talent review and calibration processes, supporting clients to make better, more consistent decisions about their people. Advise on succession planning, leadership pipeline health, and strategic workforce planning tied to business transformation agendas. Change Management and Learning Lead complex change programmes by shaping and driving the change strategy for large transformations, covering stakeholder alignment, change impact, adoption, communications and business readiness. Design learning and capability solutions, translating new processes, technologies and ways of working into practical learning journeys, role-based training, leadership development and on-the-job enablement. Advise senior clients on adoption and behaviour change, working with executives and programme leaders to identify resistance, shift mindsets, strengthen sponsorship and embed new behaviours into the organisation. Support business development and client relationships, identifying opportunities, shape proposals, contribute to pitches and position change and learning as a critical part of transformation outcomes. Practice & Business Development • Contribute to proposal development, pitch preparation, and thought leadership that positions our practice competitively in the market. • Actively participate in the talent practice community, sharing client insights, building IP, and mentoring junior practitioners. • Represent the firm at industry forums, client events, and relevant external networks. You’ll be an outstanding technical specialist with the strong communication skills needed to liaise with your clients and your colleagues. At the forefront of the industry, you’ll help make our Responsible AI vision a reality for clients looking to better serve their customers and operate always-on enterprises. We’re not just focused on increasing revenues – our technologies and innovations are making millions of lives easier and more comfortable. Participating in the full AI development lifecycle, including data preparation, design, coding, testing, deployment, and support. Contributing to the development of internal guidelines, best practices for responsible AI development and technical training. Staying updated with current AI trends, ethical considerations, and technological advancements. Assisting in the identification and correction of biases in datasets and AI models. Documenting AI development processes and maintaining a transparent record of decisions and methodologies used. Travel may be required for this role. description: We Are: We are at the forefront of a new era in enterprise AI — one defined not by model capability alone, but by the infrastructure, memory systems, and routing intelligence required to make autonomous AI agents trustworthy and commercially viable at scale. Our Data & AI practice brings together more than 45,000 professionals helping clients design, deploy, and govern AI systems across regulated industries. Our applied research function sits at the intersection of frontier AI research and production engineering — investigating the foundational challenges that will determine whether enterprise agentic AI succeeds or stalls. You Are: As a Senior Advanced AI Research Engineer, you sit at the boundary between AI systems research and production platform engineering. You investigate hard, open problems in agentic AI — and you close the loop: turning research findings into engineered prototypes, then into platform-ready capabilities that real workloads depend on. You are a strong Python engineer who can move fluently between an experiment and a well-structured service or SDK module. You write research artefacts and production code in the same week, and you understand why both matter. The Work: Applied Research & Innovation: Investigate active innovation frontiers in agentic AI systems — for example, agent memory and knowledge persistence architectures, model selection and inference routing strategies, autonomy and goal-anchoring control planes, and long-horizon task reliability. The specific focus areas evolve with client demand and research opportunity. Design and execute rigorous benchmarking and evaluation methodologies scoped to production-relevant agentic task profiles — covering dimensions such as tool use, structured output generation, multi-step reasoning, instruction following, and failure recovery. Investigate efficiency and scalability frontiers — such as inference cost reduction, context management at scale, and retrieval architecture design — that determine whether agent workloads can be served commercially on attainable hardware. Contribute to external publications, technical reports, and conference submissions that establish thought leadership and build the evidence base for client and platform decisions. Translational Engineering: Translate research findings into production-grade implementations: engineered Python services, Node.js/TypeScript SDK modules, or platform-integrated components that other engineers and agent workloads depend on. Build well-defined provider interfaces and pluggable backends for research components — memory stores, retrieval layers, routing modules — so that experimental implementations can be iterated on and swapped independently of the platform code that depends on them. How do you roll out a new AI-powered operating model across a 50,000-person organization? How do you stand up data center infrastructure fast enough to meet demand without blowing cost targets? You know how to take a strategy and make it work in practice. You understand the gap between a good plan and a plan that gets implemented, and you close it. You are energized by complexity, comfortable in fast-moving environments, and skilled at getting organizations to move. You define and track market trends while helping your clients outpace them through disciplined execution and sustained operational change. You build trust with clients that lasts beyond a single engagement, hold yourself and your team to a high bar on delivery, and show up every day focused on driving clear, measurable impact. Support business development; contributing to proposals, shaping the point of view on new opportunities, and helping grow existing client relationships. Lead the client relationship day-to-day; managing communication, setting expectations, and building trust over time. Keep internal delivery on track; coordinating across workstreams and making sure the right people are focused on the right things. Develop junior team members; give honest feedback, create real ownership opportunities, and invest in their growth. Travel: Average 40–50% (up to 80% as needed). Strong client communication skills with a proven ability to influence and inspire senior executives. A proven track record of delivery on complex, high-impact client engagements where AI played a central role. Hands-on experience applying generative AI, machine learning, or AI-powered platforms to solve real business problems. Role Description The Creative Lead is a senior visual and conceptual leader responsible for setting the creative vision across pharmaceutical and life sciences accounts. This role owns the design practice and creative delivery across one or more client accounts, overseeing multidisciplinary teams to produce strategically grounded, visually compelling solutions that translate complex science into clear, impactful stories. Working closely with Group Creative Directors, brand managers, medical writers, and cross-functional stakeholders, the Creative Lead drives omnichannel campaigns for both patients and healthcare professionals (HCPs), ensuring all outputs strictly comply with pharmaceutical regulatory and medical-legal review (MLR) requirements while maintaining creative excellence. This role manages design leads and copywriters, contributes to business development, and shapes the long-term creative culture of the team. Partner closely with copy leads to drive cohesive creative thinking across all deliverables. Oversee quality control for all visual deliverables, ensuring brand consistency and message alignment. Apply accessibility best practices (color, contrast, size) across all visual design decisions. Provide hands-on directions to designers and art directors throughout the creative process. Ensure creative innovation is achieved within the boundaries of strict pharma regulatory requirements. Maintain scientific accuracy across all promotional and educational materials. Team Leadership & Mentorship Manage, mentor, and guide copywriters, designers, art directors, and external agencies. Provide constructive feedback and model creative excellence to develop junior and mid-level talent. Foster an inclusive, collaborative creative culture within the department. Manage design leads and oversee resourcing, timelines, estimations, and forecasts across accounts. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Client Engagement Partner with Strategy, Account, Project Management, Medical Writers, Brand Managers, and Science Experts to ensure factual accuracy and strategic alignment. Present creative concepts confidently to internal stakeholders and external clients. Contribute to new business efforts by developing conceptual directions and participating in pitch presentations. Collaborate with production, UX, and development teams on multichannel executions leading GenAI practice and latest tools. Support brand planning and tactical development in partnership with cross-functional leads Required Skills & Qualifications Experience 8–10 years of relevant experience in visual/graphic design and creative team management, preferably in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or biotech creative agencies. Proven experience in pharmaceutical art direction or design within creative or advertising agencies, including AOR and product launch experience. 5+ years in a client-facing creative role with strong presentation skills. Experience driving user-centered design processes and rapid prototyping (from sketching to digital prototypes). Technical Skills Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite: Photoshop, Illustrator, XD, and InDesign (required). Advanced proficiency in Figma and Gen AI tools. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office: PowerPoint, Word, and Excel. Strong knowledge of UI/UX principles: User Experience, Design Thinking, Interaction Design, Accessibility Design, Usability Testing, and Competitive Analysis. Working knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, or other project methodologies. Illustration specialist or Data Visualization skills are an advantage. Domain Knowledge Scientific literacy: ability to read and interpret dense clinical trial data and medical content. Deep familiarity with pharmaceutical promotional review processes (OPDP, MLR). Strong understanding of omnichannel campaign delivery for both HCP and patient audiences. Soft Skills Strong portfolio demonstrates aesthetic and strategically creative solutions across multiple formats and channels. Excellent oral and written communication skills in English and Spanish (required for LATAM and North America clients). Creative problem-solving with the ability to brainstorm, ideate, and respond quickly with innovative, original concepts. Open-minded, flexible, and optimistic adapting to change. Strong interpersonal skills for requirements gathering and communication across teams, workstreams, and clients. Desired Skills Experience in rare disease or oncology therapeutic areas. Experience in multinational pharmaceutical organizations or large healthcare agencies. Experience working with medical affairs and scientific communication teams. Knowledge of digital accessibility standards (WCAG) and inclusive design principles. Familiarity with emerging design technologies, AI-assisted design tools, and production best practices. Track record of contributing to new business pitches and agency growth initiatives. Bachelor’s degree in visual communications, Graphic Design, or a related field. title: Coordenador(a) de N1 - SOC (Security Operations Center)
additional_locations: Rio de Janeiro - Rio de Janerio; Fortaleza, Scopa Platinum Corporate; Recife, Armazem 12
description: Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de N1 para responder pelas pessoas e pela qualidade da triagem de alertas do nosso SOC. Desenvolve a equipe, sustenta o padrão de triagem e mantém as métricas operacionais em níveis saudáveis, garantindo a qualidade do atendimento. Foco na equipe, no processo e escala. Sobre a oportunidade Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar como Coordenador(a) de SOC N1 em uma operação de Managed Security Services, responsável por liderar analistas e apoiar a sustentação de um ambiente SOC multi-cliente. A posição terá papel central na gestão de pessoas, qualidade da triagem, cumprimento dos níveis de serviço e evolução contínua da operação. Procuramos uma liderança capaz de transformar indicadores e ocorrências operacionais em decisões, planos de ação e melhorias sustentáveis. Sua missão: Garantir uma operação de SOC N1 eficiente, padronizada e orientada a risco, assegurando: Cumprimento dos SLAs e OLAs; Qualidade e consistência na triagem de alertas; Desenvolvimento técnico e comportamental da equipe; Cobertura operacional adequada; Rastreabilidade das decisões; Integração eficiente entre N1, N2, N3, Engenharia e Gestão. O Coordenador será responsável por gerir as pessoas e a qualidade da torre ao longo das semanas e meses. Deverá orientar e acompanhar a distribuição das atividades com os Shift Leads. Principais responsabilidades Gestão operacional: Acompanhar os indicadores da operação, incluindo MTTA, cumprimento de SLA, aging da fila, produtividade, qualidade e taxa de escalonamento; Identificar tendências, desvios e gargalos entre turnos, clientes e tipos de alerta; Definir e acompanhar planos de ação para recuperação de SLA, redução de backlog e melhoria da qualidade; Garantir que os processos de monitoramento, triagem, classificação, enriquecimento e escalonamento sejam executados de forma padronizada; Atuar como ponto de escalonamento da operação em situações críticas ou recorrentes; Apoiar a gestão de incidentes relevantes, respeitando as responsabilidades e os limites de atuação definidos para N1, N2 e N3; Garantir que exceções, decisões operacionais e ações de contingência sejam registradas nos sistemas apropriados. Gestão de pessoas: Liderar, orientar e desenvolver analistas e lideranças operacionais; Conduzir reuniões individuais, feedbacks, planos de desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de carreira; Apoiar processos de seleção, contratação, onboarding e capacitação; Identificar lacunas de conhecimento e organizar ações de treinamento e nivelamento; Estabelecer expectativas claras de desempenho, qualidade, colaboração e comportamento profissional; Trabalhar na retenção, engajamento e preparação de talentos para evolução dentro do SOC; Tratar ocorrências relacionadas a pessoas, recorrências de comportamento e necessidades de desenvolvimento. A gestão de pessoas prevista para a função inclui 1:1s, desenvolvimento, avaliação, contratação e onboarding, utilizando os insumos operacionais dos Shift Leads. Escalas e continuidade operacional Planejar e manter as escalas de trabalho da equipe; Garantir cobertura mínima e distribuição adequada de competências entre turnos; Administrar férias, ausências, trocas e necessidades de reposição; Manter planos de contingência para situações de indisponibilidade de pessoas ou aumento excepcional de demanda; Trabalhar com os Shift Leads para assegurar passagens de turno estruturadas; Avaliar capacidade versus demanda, antecipando riscos de cobertura e impacto nos SLAs. Requisitos: Experiência em operações de Security Operations Center; Experiência anterior em liderança de equipes de segurança, operações de TI ou resposta a incidentes; Conhecimento dos processos de monitoramento, triagem, investigação inicial e escalonamento de alertas; Experiência com gestão de SLAs, backlog, capacidade e indicadores operacionais; Conhecimento de soluções SIEM, SOAR, EDR ou XDR e plataformas ITSM; Capacidade de interpretar métricas e transformar dados operacionais em planos de ação; Experiência com processos, playbooks, runbooks, controles de qualidade e melhoria contínua; Conhecimento de gestão de incidentes e fundamentos de resposta a incidentes; Boa comunicação escrita e verbal; Capacidade de liderar equipes em ambiente dinâmico, crítico e orientado a serviços; Inglês profissional para interação com documentação, ferramentas e equipes globais. Será considerado diferencial: Experiência em operações multi-cliente de Managed Security Services; Vivência em ambientes 24x7 e gestão de escalas; Experiência com programas de QA para triagem de segurança; Conhecimento de NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-61, MITRE ATT&CK, ITIL ou ISO/IEC 27001; Conhecimento de automação aplicada ao SOC; Experiência com ambientes de cloud security, identidade, redes, endpoint ou segurança OT/ICS; Certificações relacionadas a segurança, gestão de serviços, cloud ou resposta a incidentes. Competências que buscamos: Liderança com capacidade de desenvolver pessoas; Senso de urgência e priorização por risco; Tomada de decisão sob pressão; Visão analítica e orientação por indicadores; Comunicação clara, objetiva e adequada ao público; Organização e disciplina operacional; Capacidade de negociação e gestão de conflitos; Colaboração entre diferentes equipes; Mentalidade de melhoria contínua; Compromisso com qualidade, conformidade e experiência do cliente. title: GN I&E S&P Data Center Construction Manager
description: Data Center Construction Manager Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Data Center Construction Manager to oversee the end-to-end delivery of mission-critical data center projects. You will manage general contractors, MEP subcontractors, and commissioning agents to ensure facilities are delivered on schedule, within budget, and to specification. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in critical facility systems with strong project leadership skills, enabling seamless handoff to operations teams. Key Responsibilities Lead day-to-day construction management of new data center builds and retrofits, including ground-up campuses, shell-and-core fit-outs, and critical infrastructure upgrades. Manage RFP/RFQ processes, bid leveling, and contract award for general contractors and specialty subcontractors (structural, civil, electrical, mechanical, fire suppression, and low-voltage). Coordinate with design teams (architects, structural/MEP engineers) to resolve field conflicts, issue RFIs, and manage design submittals and shop drawings. Develop and maintain master project schedules (P6 or MS Project), tracking milestones for sitework, steel erection, MEP rough-in, commissioning, and IT readiness. Oversee commissioning and integrated systems testing (IST) for power systems (UPS, generators, switchgear, PDUs), cooling infrastructure (CRAC/CRAH, chillers, cooling towers, liquid cooling), and life-safety systems. Manage project budgets from $50M to $500M+, including monthly cost reporting, change order evaluation, and forecasting CapEx/OpEx through project closeout. Enforce EHS compliance on site, conducting daily safety walks, toolbox talks, and incident investigations in alignment with OSHA standards and corporate safety programs. Coordinate vendor qualification and equipment procurement for critical path items (transformers, generators, UPS systems, cooling equipment) to mitigate supply chain risks. Serve as primary liaison between ownership, design consultants, contractors, and local authorities having jurisdiction (AHJ) for permitting, inspections, and Certificate of Occupancy. Mentor and supervise construction coordinators, site engineers, and owner's representative staff embedded on project sites. Preferred Skills Experience with hyperscale or colocation data center campuses exceeding 50MW critical IT load. Knowledge of sustainable construction practices including LEED certification, water usage effectiveness (WUE), and energy modeling for PUE optimization. Background in modular or prefabricated data center construction (e.g., skid-mounted power, containerized cooling). Familiarity with liquid cooling infrastructure: direct liquid cooling (DLC), rear-door heat exchangers, and immersion cooling systems. Experience with BIM coordination (Revit, Navisworks) for clash detection and construction sequencing. Qualifications Bachelor's/Master’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field; PMP or CCM certification preferred. 7+ years of construction management experience, with at least 3 years on mission-critical or data center projects in a direct management capacity. Demonstrated expertise in critical facility systems: medium-voltage switchgear, diesel generators, UPS systems, HVAC/chiller plants, and fire suppression. Proficiency in project scheduling tools (Primavera P6, MS Project) and construction management platforms (Procore, e-Builder, or equivalent). Strong command of commissioning processes including Level 1–5 testing, IST, and DCIM/BMS integration validation. Familiarity with data center standards and guidelines: Uptime Institute Tier Classifications, TIA-942, ASHRAE TC 9.9, and NFPA 75/76. Proven ability to manage multi-prime contract structures and navigate complex stakeholder environments across ownership, design, and contractor teams. Willingness to travel to site visits, project kickoffs, and commissioning events. title: DevOps Engineer
description: Project Role : DevOps Engineer Project Role Description : Responsible for building and setting up new development tools and infrastructure utilizing knowledge in continuous integration, delivery, and deployment (CI/CD), Cloud technologies, Container Orchestration and Security. Build and test end-to-end CI/CD pipelines, ensuring that systems are safe against security threats. Must have skills : ServiceNow IT Service Management (ITSM) Good to have skills : NA Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: As a DevOps Engineer, your day involves designing and implementing new development tools and infrastructure to support software development processes. You will focus on creating and maintaining continuous integration and delivery pipelines, ensuring smooth and efficient deployment cycles. Your role includes collaborating with various teams to enhance system reliability and security, while managing cloud environments and container orchestration platforms. title: Healthcare Epic Data Consulting Analyst
description: Job Title: Configuration Analyst – EMR Systems (Epic Preferred) Role Overview: We are seeking a Configuration Analyst with strong hands-on experience in configuring and supporting enterprise EMR/HIS platforms to join our healthcare technology team. In this role, you will act as a configuration expert, collaborating closely with clinical and technical teams to ensure system stability, seamless integration, and a superior user experience. While experience with Epic modules is preferred, candidates with strong configuration experience in other EMR systems such as Cerner, Allscripts, MEDITECH, or similar platforms are also encouraged to apply. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include workflow analysis, system configuration, troubleshooting, issue resolution, and driving enhancements to optimize operational efficiency and patient care outcomes. Key Responsibilities: Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for assigned EMR modules, ensuring accurate configuration, maintenance, and optimization. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (clinical, technical, integration, and business) to gather requirements, troubleshoot issues, and implement solutions. Participate in build, testing, and validation activities, ensuring system integrity, compliance, and performance. Troubleshoot and resolve issues across applications, interfaces, and integrations in a timely and structured manner. Document configuration changes, workflows, and knowledge articles to support operational excellence and knowledge transfer. Provide mentoring and training to junior analysts and contribute to team capability building. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and solution design discussions. Professional & Technical Skills: Must Have: Hands-on configuration experience in at least one major EMR system (e.g., Epic, Cerner, Allscripts, MEDITECH, or similar). Strong understanding of hospital workflows and clinical operations. Proven ability to perform end-to-end configuration, troubleshooting, and testing with minimal supervision. Exposure to working with integration/interfaces between EMR and external systems. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on enhancing user experience. Preferred (Epic): Active Epic certification in one or more of the following modules: Willow Inpatient, Ambulatory, Radiant, Cupid, OpTime, Professional Billing (PB), Orders, Beacon, Care Everywhere, EpicCare Link, ClinDoc / Stork, ASAP, Bugsy. Interfaces/Bridges Integration experience across Epic and third-party systems. Exposure to multiple Epic modules beyond the primary certification. Qualifications & Experience: Experience: Minimum 3 years of EMR system configuration and support experience. Education: 15 years of full-time education (Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required). Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills with clinical and IT teams. Experience working in healthcare delivery or consulting environments is an added advantage. Note: While Epic certification and experience are preferred for this role, candidates with solid EMR configuration experience in other platforms will also be considered. description: As an Accenture Flex employee, you will apply your skills and experience to help drive business transformation for leading organizations and communities. description: This role is part of Accenture Research’s Economics of AI center of excellence and Economic Research team. The ideal candidate will be able to connect macroeconomic trends with industry dynamics and enterprise-level implications, translating data and model outputs into relevant insights for business and research stakeholders. The candidate will be working closely with other teams of economists, data scientists, market researchers, and industry experts to guarantee a successful collaboration between data-driven outputs and storytelling deliverables. The ideal candidate has a passion for economics and data-driven insight discovery as well as business acumen to help solve the world’s most complex problems at the intersection of economics, business, technology, and society. Minimum of 2 years in a technical leadership role (code reviews, architecture sign-offs, client workshops). Prior experience supporting the CMT industry/clients Prior experience in a Consulting/Advisory role. Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years' work experience). description: Accenture Flex offers you the flexibility of local fixed-duration project-based work powered by Accenture, a leading global professional services company. As an Accenture Flex employee, you will apply your skills and experience to help drive business transformation for leading organizations and communities. In addition to delivering innovative solutions for Accenture's clients, you will work with a highly skilled, diverse network of people across Accenture businesses who are using the latest emerging technologies to address today's biggest business challenges. You will receive competitive rewards and access to benefits programs and world-class learning resources. Accenture Flex employees work in their local metro area onsite at the project, significantly reducing and/or eliminating the demands to travel. Role Overview: The Scheduler Lead provides critical operational leadership and governance for all scheduling activities supporting case studies. This role is accountable for ensuring accurate, timely, and efficient participant scheduling across all sites and geographies, aligned to volume targets, site capacity, and proctor availability. As a key leader, you will oversee scheduler teams, establish standardized processes, and serve as the primary escalation point for complex challenges, priority requests, and systemic capacity constraints. This role is vital to meeting service levels, maximizing utilization, and enabling the predictable delivery of case study volumes. The Scheduler Lead will also work with the Schedulers to develop strategic approaches for Schedulers in other locations to efficiently identify candidates for case studies and increase end user participation. Key Responsibilities: Operational Leadership: Lead and coordinate day-to-day scheduling operations across all case study sites and participant types, including internal, external, and pilot groups. Governance & Standards: Own scheduling governance, standards, and operating procedures to ensure consistent execution across different geographies and teams. Strategic Alignment: Partner with Proctor Leads, Site Leads, and Program Management to align participant scheduling plans with site capacity, proctor staffing, and forecasted demand. Escalation Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for complex scheduling issues, conflicts, high-priority requests, and rapid-turnaround collection needs. Performance Monitoring: Monitor and report on scheduling KPIs, including fill rates, utilization, no-shows, cancellations, and reschedule trends. Continuous Improvement: Drive initiatives to reduce scheduling friction, improve participant experience, and increase overall schedule reliability. Team Development: Ensure scheduler teams are trained, compliant with protocols, and equipped with the tools needed to support evolving study requirements. Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with recruiting, quality, and data teams to address systemic constraints impacting volume delivery or scheduling accuracy. People Management: Provide structured coaching, feedback, and performance input for Scheduler team members in alignment with the staffing model. Growth Planning: Support planning activities for ramp-ups, pilots, and new site launches by defining scheduling assumptions and capacity models. This role is 100% onsite at our client's office in San Francisco Basic Qualifications: Minimum 2 years of work experience Advanced Scheduling: Expertise in capacity planning across multi-site operations. Workforce Alignment: Ability to align demand with operational constraints. Analytics: Proficiency in KPI tracking, reporting, and trend analysis. Process Design: Skilled in process definition, standardization, and governance. System Knowledge: Experience with participant scheduling systems and databases. Operational Leadership: Strong team management and leadership capabilities. Stakeholder Communication: Clear and confident communication with cross-functional stakeholders. Decisive Problem-Solving: Ability to solve problems effectively under time and volume pressure. Strategic Balance: Ability to balance participant experience with operational efficiency. Mentorship: A coaching mindset dedicated to developing scheduler capability. title: Meetings & Events Central Operations Planner Analyst with English
description: Your career is about what you want to be and who you want to be. It’s about bringing your skills, curiosity and best true self to work. At Accenture Operations , we rethink the way people work and businesses perform by harnessing the power of rich data for decision-making, innovative technology and advanced machine intelligence. German, Spanish, Portuguese and Nordic languages are also considered a plus. Provide stakeholder support and timely issue escalation management to ensure consistent and satisfactory delivery across Market Units. Own and oversee event closure activities, including financial reconciliation, invoice tracking, audit support and data accuracy in reporting systems. Skills that make your work successful: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent. Minimum 1 year of relevant Meetings Management / Corporate Meeting Planner experience in a multinational organization. Hands-on experience in event planning, venue sourcing, supplier coordination, budget management, attendee management and on-site event execution . Experience with event technology tools , preferably Cvent, StarCite, Eved, Delphi, Opera or similar. Solid understanding of Strategic Meetings Management concepts and the end-to-end event lifecycle. Fluent English , both written and spoken. Strong Microsoft Office skills and excellent organizational and stakeholder management skills. Additional European languages are highly valued, particularly French or Italian ; German, Spanish, Portuguese and Nordic languages are considered a plus. description: Job Description: Join the Accenture Labs’ AI R&D Team and work on core AI Models / technology that work across multiple domains. The Opportunity As an Applied Scientist , you will sit at the intersection of advanced AI research and real-world business impact . You will translate state-of-the-art machine learning and AI techniques into practical, scalable solutions that solve complex problems across real datasets, products, and client environments. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys moving beyond pure research to own the end-to-end lifecycle of AI solutions—from problem formulation and experimentation to validation, deployment, and measurable outcomes. Key Responsibilities & Impact This role offers a unique mix of deep research and hands-on development: Research Synthesis : Review, analyze, and strategically summarize the latest academic and industry research in technical domains (e.g., LLM domain adaptation, knowledge integration, reasoning techniques). Adapt foundation and compact language models to specialized domains using techniques such as fine-tuning, continued pre-training, distillation, and parameter-efficient methods (e.g. LoRA). Design and implement agentic LLM systems that integrate external tools (APIs, databases, services, rule engines) to perform precision and verifiable tasks. Hands-on Prototype Development : Collaborate directly with Senior Research Scientists to rapidly design, build, and test Proof-of-Concepts. Research Dissemination : Articulate complex research findings into clear, persuasive, and publishable papers and presentations for both academic and business audiences. Strategic Storytelling : Craft engaging narratives and technical demonstrations that translate research outcomes into clear, compelling value propositions. Job Qualifications : Master’s plus 2-3 years industry experience or PhD in Computer Science / AI (Area of Study: AI / ML / NLP) with 1-2 years industry experience. Strong foundation in machine learning, including supervised learning, embeddings, evaluation metrics, and data preprocessing. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills. Good written and verbal communication abilities, with the capacity to structure presentations for maximum clarity and impact. Experimental design expertise, including the ability to design controlled experiments, define meaningful baselines, and interpret results using appropriate quantitative metrics. Ability to collaborate effectively with researchers, engineers, and product stakeholders in cross-functional environments. Ability to track, evaluate, and apply relevant research literature. Strong programming skills in Python, including experience with libraries such as PyTorch (preferred), TensorFlow. Primary Skills: Ability to implement custom models (neural networks, transformers), layers, or loss functions. Small Language Models (SLMs): hands-on experience building, adapting, and evaluating compact language models; understanding of domain adaptation techniques, efficiency trade-offs, and deployment constraints. Agentic LLMs & Tool Use: experience integrating LLMs with external tools and systems to execute structured, multi-step tasks with high precision. Experience integrating external knowledge sources into LLM/SLM systems, such as databases, document collections, knowledge graphs, or rule-based systems. Demonstrated ability to combine model reasoning, external knowledge, and tools into reliable end-to-end systems. Bonus Skills (Not Required but Valuable) Prior experience in an AI research lab, applied research group, or advanced R&D environment. Publications, preprints, or open-source contributions. title: Agentic Commerce Senior Manager | Industrial
description: We Are Accenture Song accelerates growth and value for our clients through sustained customer relevance. Our capabilities span ideation to execution: growth, product and experience design; technology and experience platforms; creative, media and marketing strategy; and campaign, content and channel orchestration. With strong client relationships and deep industry expertise, we help our clients operate at the speed of life through the unlimited potential of imagination, technology and intelligence. Visit us at: www.accenture.com/song Overview We are seeking a Senior Manager to lead the design and delivery of agentic commerce transformation programs for industrial clients. This role will help manufacturers, equipment OEMs, distributors, and industrial services organizations adapt to a new model of customer engagement where AI-powered agents, conversational interfaces, and intelligent systems increasingly influence how products, parts, services, and solutions are discovered, evaluated, specified, and transacted. As industrial buying journeys evolve beyond traditional sales channels, organizations must rethink how their specifications, product content, pricing logic, aftermarket services, channel relationships, platforms, and data are structured to operate within AI-driven and ecosystem-based environments. This Senior Manager will translate strategic vision into actionable programs, commercial value cases, and implementation roadmaps that modernize how industrial companies compete in agent-mediated buying journeys. You will serve as a senior client-facing leader and lead multidisciplinary teams across strategy, digital experience, content, platform integration, data, sales, and account teams. You will help clients improve how their products, services, and commercial propositions show up across search, AI interfaces, procurement workflows, dealer ecosystems, and partner platforms, while building the operating and technical readiness required for scalable agent interaction. The ideal candidate combines deep industrial or manufacturing expertise , digital and commercial strategy experience, strong program leadership, and an understanding of how AI and agent-based experiences are reshaping complex B2B buying journeys. Job Responsibilities Agentic Commerce Strategy & Transformation Leadership Lead major workstreams that map how industrial buyers, fleet operators, dealers, and procurement teams navigate agent-influenced journeys across discovery, TCO comparison, specification evaluation, RFQ, purchase, service, and renewal. Identify where agent mediation creates friction, risk, or competitive advantage, and redesign journeys, propositions, and operating models around the emerging behavior rather than defending legacy channels. Translate emerging agentic commerce trends into industrial use cases, GTM plays, investment priorities, commercial value cases, and executable transformation roadmaps. Advise senior client leaders on how to compete across direct , dealer, distributor, marketplace, and procurement ecosystems as buying decisions become increasingly AI-mediated. Digital Experience & Discoverability Lead initiatives that improve how industrial products, aftermarket services, and commercial propositions are discovered, interpreted, compared, and engaged across digital and AI-enabled environments. Define strategies to improve discoverability across search, conversational interfaces, procurement platforms, partner ecosystems, and industrial marketplaces. Guide content , UX, product, and platform teams in structuring experiences for both human decision-makers and machine interpretation. Oversee optimization of product pages, service journeys, specification content, and digital experiences to strengthen visibility, trust, and conversion. Agent Communication & Execution Readiness Define the commercial and technical strategy required when agents expect real-time answers on pricing, availability, lead times, delivery commitments, service coverage, and contract terms. Position agent readiness as a competitive requirement for winning agent-mediated evaluations, not solely a data engineering task, and quantify where slow, incomplete, or inconsistent commercial data weakens client performance. Partner with engineering, product, data, and platform leadership to define integration approaches and expose endpoints across catalog, pricing, quote, availability, fulfillment, entitlement, and service workflows. Lead development of scalable frameworks for AI-assisted quoting, purchasing, renewal, parts ordering, and service transactions. Monitoring, Trust & Technical Governance Establish structured data quality, monitoring, and governance frameworks across product, parts, service, pricing, contract, and dealer information. Identify gaps affecting citation eligibility, recommendation logic, specification matching, comparison outcomes, or transaction reliability. Define governance standards for structured updates across business units, markets, product lines, and channel partners. Partner with legal, security, and risk teams to help ensure APIs, data feeds, and agent interactions align with privacy, compliance, brand safety, and responsible AI requirements. Data & AI Readiness Lead efforts to structure product, customer, service, dealer, and transaction data for analytics, personalization, recommendations, and AI use cases. Identify where improved data can strengthen decision-making, TCO comparisons, uptime recommendations, service renewal, and customer experience. Collaborate with data and technology leaders to improve the accessibility, quality, interoperability, and usability of commercial data across digital channels and ecosystem partners. Translate business priorities into clear data and AI-readiness requirements for technical roadmaps. Client Engagement & Program Leadership Serve as a senior client-facing leader responsible for delivering complex agentic commerce and digital ecosystem transformation programs. Lead multidisciplinary teams across strategy, technology, experience, content, data, and analytics, with accountability for outcomes, quality, and delivery excellence. Lead executive workshops, working sessions, steering updates, and decision forums that align commercial, sales, digital, service, procurement, and technology stakeholders. Translate complex technical and strategic concepts into clear recommendations for senior client leaders and build alignment around priorities, investment choices, and execution plans. Coach Managers, Consultants, and Analysts and contribute to a high-performing, inclusive team environment. Innovation & Capability Development Help shape Accenture capabilities at the intersection of Industrials, B2B commerce, AI, and digital ecosystems. Identify emerging technologies, market shifts, and competitive patterns affecting industrial customer engagement and distribution models. Contribute to thought leadership, reusable methods, industry propositions, and client development activities for agentic commerce. Collaborate across Accenture Song, Technology, Strategy, and industry teams to develop differentiated offerings and support business development. Experience leading digital transformation, customer experience, commercial strategy, sales effectiveness, product experience, or platform-related initiatives Strong understanding of complex B2B buying journeys, industrial channels, dealer or distributor ecosystems, and aftermarket services Experience with AI-driven customer experiences, conversational interfaces, emerging digital ecosystem trends, or machine-readable content and data structures Understanding of digital marketing, content strategy, product information management, commerce platforms, product experience optimization, or API-based integrations Experience collaborating with engineering, product, data, or platform leadership to prioritize AI-readiness initiatives on technical roadmaps Proven ability to lead complex programs, manage cross-functional teams, and influence senior client stakeholders Experience developing strategic roadmaps and translating them into actionable delivery plans and measurable business outcomes Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Business , Marketing, Computer Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Industrial Management, or a related field Strong problem-solving, analytical, and technical, and executive stakeholders Experience supporting business development, proposal development, or capability building in a consulting environment Passion for innovation and the future of title: Data Science Research Manager - Accenture Research
location: New York, One Manhattan West, Corp
description: We Are: We are Accenture Research, a team specialized in delivering impact through thought leadership and client insights. Our AI & Data Science team sits at the frontier of applied AI, combining rigorous quantitative methods with the latest in generative AI, agentic systems, and synthetic data generation to deliver differentiated intelligence for Accenture’s clients and internal stakeholders. We operate like a research lab with the accountability of a consulting team. Our work spans industries, geographies, and problem types — and we build the tools and methodologies that power it. We partner with world-class institutions including MIT Sloan and The Wharton School, and we invest in long-horizon research alongside immediate client impact. If you want to do the most technically ambitious, strategically relevant work of your career — in an environment that values rigor, craft, and intellectual honesty — this is the team. This role sits within Accenture Research’s AI team— a team built to develop next-generation research capabilities. We operate at the frontier of applied AI, combining rigorous quantitative methods with the latest in generative AI, agentic systems, and synthetic data generation to deliver differentiated intelligence for Accenture’s clients and internal stakeholders. You Are: We are looking for a manager-level data scientist who brings a rare combination of very strong business acumen and technical fluency. You will support high-impact client engagements across industries by designing and deploying machine learning models, GenAI pipelines, and agentic AI workflows. You will be a core contributor to the team’s portfolio of reusable, scalable analytical assets — including synthetic persona systems and intelligent agent frameworks — built on a GCP-first technology stack. The Work: In this role, you’ll be reporting into the Research Principal Director, AI and Data Science, and will work as a senior individual contributor and team lead across a portfolio of client and internal research engagements. The work is highly varied — spanning model-building, client workshops, and thought leadership — and is always tied to real decisions and real audiences. Key Responsibilities Translate complex business problems into well-scoped, researchable analytical questions with clearly defined outputs and success metrics Collaborate with research leads, economists, and client-facing teams to embed AI-native tools into project delivery Design, build, and deliver ML and GenAI-powered analytical methodologies to support client engagements across multiple industries Develop and iterate synthetic persona generation pipelines, including large-scale digital executive personas and behavioral simulation models Implement agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as Google ADK, A2A, and MCP protocols on GCP Design and maintain real-time intelligence dashboards and AI-as-a-service analytical assets Coach and mentor junior data scientists, fostering a culture of technical rigor and business relevance What's In It For You? You’ll have access to 100+ proprietary business data sources through Accenture Research’s global data lake — the kind of depth you won’t find anywhere else. You’ll get a mandate to build at the frontier: agentic pipelines, synthetic intelligence systems, and AI-native research assets that are genuinely new. You’ll collaborate with world-class academic institutions including MIT Sloan and The Wharton School, with the opportunity to publish and present externally. You’ll have dedicated time to develop novel methodologies beyond immediate project constraints — because we believe great research needs room to breathe. You’ll gain leadership exposure across Accenture’s global industry and capability networks, working with senior stakeholders across sectors. You’ll join a team that values auditability, rigor, and craft in every analytical deliverable — and that holds itself to that standard. The work location for this role will include a mix of working remotely and working onsite. With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs. Here's What You Need: Minimum of 5 years delivering analytical outputs in client-facing or commercial settings, with demonstrated ability to translate technical findings for executive audiences. Minimum of 5 years applying machine learning methods, including simulations, supervised/unsupervised models, NLP, and time series. Minimum of 2 years of experience with generative AI — including LLM prompting strategies, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-modal models. Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience designing and building agentic AI architectures, including tool-use patterns, planning loops, and multi-agent orchestration. Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Strategy, Economics, or a related field with minimum 5 years of work experience. Master’s degree with minimum 5 years of work experience. PhD is a plus. Technical Skills Python (advanced): modeling, data wrangling, pipeline development, and API integration. Machine learning: supervised and unsupervised methods, ensemble models, time series, NLP, and text analytics. Generative AI: LLM prompting, fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and multi-modal models. Agentic AI: experience building agent architectures including tool use, planning loops, and multi-agent orchestration. Synthetic data generation: methods such as SDV, Gaussian Copula Synthesizer, IPF calibration, or equivalent. Google Cloud Platform (GCP) — critical requirement: Cloud Run, BigQuery, Vertex AI, Secret Manager, and GCP deployment architecture. Soft Skills & Mindset Strong business acumen: ability to contextualize analytical findings within industry dynamics and C-suite decision-making. Excellent communication skills — written, verbal, and visual — for presenting to executive and non-technical audiences. Strategic problem-solving mindset: comfortable moving from ambiguous business context to a structured analytical approach. Strong project and stakeholder management capabilities in fast-paced, global environments. Enthusiasm for cross-functional, multicultural teamwork with a bias toward building durable, reusable infrastructure. Bonus Points if You Have: Experience designing and facilitating client workshops, co-creation sessions, or executive briefings in a consulting or advisory context. Published thought leadership — white papers, industry reports, or HBR-style research — with demonstrated ability to synthesize complex AI topics for non-technical audiences. Deep vertical expertise in at least one industry (e.g., financial services, consumer goods, healthcare, energy) with a track record of designing industry-specific AI solutions. Experience with synthetic data generation methods (SDV, Gaussian Copula Synthesizer, IPF calibration, or equivalent) in research or commercial settings. Background in academic or institutional research collaborations, such as with business schools or think tanks.
